verdict.rationale: Bun generates and respects a lockfile (bun.lock) that pins exact resolved versions, and `--frozen-lockfile` explicitly installs exact versions without updating, enforcing reproducibility across environments; global installs (`-g`) support pinning CLI tool versions too. Overrides/resolutions further let projects force exact versions of transitive deps. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of pin-respect behavior (community evidence covers monorepo/runtime issues, not pin-fidelity tests).
